chosen_titles.rationale: Title III - Legislative Branch; Commissions (Ch. 10-11) houses Ch. 11 with the legislative-branch lobbyist registration and compensation/expenditure reporting statute (F.S. 11.045).

Title X - Public Officers, Employees, and Records (Ch. 110-122) houses Ch. 112 Part III (Code of Ethics), which includes the executive-branch lobbyist registration and reporting statute (F.S. 112.3215) administered by the Commission on Ethics.

notes: FL has a dual lobbying-disclosure regime split across two titles: legislative-branch lobbying in Title III Ch. 11 and executive-branch lobbying in Title X Ch. 112. Both titles returned per the pass-1 prompt's explicit guidance on parallel-regime states (FL named as example). Vintage 2025 available on Justia.
